title: Board Skills, Incentives and Action Plan
summary: Brings the programme together into a board action plan covering the board's own capability, committee mandates, remuneration and incentives, and keeping governance current as standards evolve.
contentGaps: Written as part of a programme: Aim and Purpose is the module's one-line description; audience, prior knowledge and core reading come from the programme

sections.Aim and Purpose: Brings the programme together into a board action plan covering the board's own capability, committee mandates, remuneration and incentives, and keeping governance current as standards evolve.
Learning Objectives: Assess the board's sustainability expertise and plan to close gaps
Evaluate how remuneration and incentives support sustainability objectives
Produce a board action plan for climate and sustainability oversight
Syllabus: Board skills, committee mandates and external advice
Linking sustainability metrics to remuneration without perverse incentives
Emerging themes: nature, social risk and transition finance
Workshop: the board's twelve-month climate and sustainability oversight plan
Intended Audience: Chairs, non-executive and independent directors and board committee members, especially on risk, audit and sustainability committees
Executive directors and senior managers accountable for strategy, risk, sustainability and disclosure
Company secretaries and heads of governance supporting board oversight of sustainability
sections.Useful Prior Knowledge and Experience: Board or senior management experience in financial services is helpful. No technical background in climate science or sustainability reporting is required.
Core Reading: ISSB, IFRS S1 General Requirements and IFRS S2 Climate-related Disclosures (2023)
TCFD, Recommendations of the Task Force on Climate-related Financial Disclosures (2017)
Basel Committee, Principles for the Effective Management and Supervision of Climate-related Financial Risks (2022)
TNFD, Recommendations of the Taskforce on Nature-related Financial Disclosures (2023)
